rationale: 候选第二命题截断于『a proprietary 43B GPT and Lla』，源文本核心结果命题缺失：『LLM with 4K context window using simple retrieval-augmentation at generation can achieve comparable performance to finetuned LLM with 16K context window』『retrieval can significantly improve the performance of LLMs regardless of their extended context window sizes』『retrieval-augmented Llama2-70B with 32K context window, outperforms GPT-3.5-turbo-16k and Davinci003』，含数值与因果结论的关键命题遗漏，E3。
